name: Keflavík International Airport

runway.v: two runways, 01/19 and 10/28; longest take-off run 3,065 m (runway 10/28)

hours.v: open 24 hours every day of the year
hours.quote: The aerodrome is a public aerodrome, operating 24 hours every day of the year.

slots.v: fully slot-coordinated (IATA Level 3); general and business aviation follow the coordinator's GA/BA (GCR) guidelines
slots.quote: Keflavík International Airport is a fully coordinated level 3 airport (SCR).

also.quote: Keflavik Airport is a fully coordinated Level 3 airport (SCR).

handling.v: the operator lists four FBO/service providers: Airport Associates, Iceland Jet Center, South Air, Iceland Aero Agents

notes: AIP Iceland AD 2 BIKF (eaip.isavia.is, AIRAC A 09/2026 effective 1 Oct 2026) could not be opened: the HTML page failed at the site (client error) in every form tried, and the Latin-1 encoded URL was blocked (permission not answered). Isavia AIP SUP 15/2026 (effective 14 May 2026) was read: terminal apron works for about three years from 26 May 2026, stands 1, 3 and 5 closed; it says nothing on GA/BA. Rules here come from the operator's Aerodrome Manual v13.0 (29 Jun 2026; declared distances section 6.10: RWY 10 TORA 3065 m, RWY 01/19 TORA 3054 m; night operations section states no restriction but is not a statement that there is none, so curfew stays missing) and the kefairport.com airport information page. The manual says runway physical data are in AIP AD 2.12, not read. Customs/immigration hours not stated in any page read.
